entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Ugh, finally. I've been on hold forever. This is absolutely unacceptable!
Hello, thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. I can definitely help you today. What seems to be the problem?
The problem is that I spent good money on a jersey from your company and it's completely wrong! I want to return this thing, now. This is ridiculous.

I can certainly look into that for you. I understand your frustration. To make sure I address this correctly, is the issue with the jersey a technical fault, like a rip or a bad zipper, or is it more of a preference issue?
Are you serious? Did you not hear me? It's the wrong size! It's so tight I can barely breathe in it. I need to exchange it. Are you going to help me or do I need to speak to your manager?
My apologies, I just needed to clarify. I can absolutely handle this for you, no need for a manager. A sizing issue is a common reason for an exchange. Let me just pull up your order.
You'd better. I swear if this is some complicated process, I'm lighting you guys up on every review site on the internet. I expect a full refund or the right item.

I understand completely. I see your order here, and you received it just last week. For apparel like a jersey, you're well within our 90-day return window. We can definitely get you an exchange for a different size or process a full refund. It's your choice.
Wait, really? 90 days? So you can actually do it? You're not going to give me some runaround about it being past a week?

Not at all. The policy is clear for jerseys. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return shipping label right now. Just pack up the jersey that was too tight, put this label on the box, and drop it off. Would you like me to process the exchange for the next size up, or would you prefer the refund?
Oh. Okay. A pre-paid label. Fine. Yes, send me the exchange for the larger size.

Excellent. I've just initiated the exchange order for you. You should see that confirmation email along with the return label in your inbox within the next few minutes. Once we see the original item has been shipped, your new jersey will be sent out.
Alright. Well, that's better than I expected. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it. Just make sure it gets here.
We will. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
